subject: SOC2 evidence: personnel onboarding/offboarding artifact index & sampling plan
messages:
From: Claire Jensen <claire@brightlineaudit.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 request — personnel evidence sampling and index

Hi Naomi,

Following our kickoff call last week we need a concise index of personnel-related artifacts for the SOC2 inspection. Specifically, the reviewer team is looking for:

- A single spreadsheet that lists every onboarding/offboarding artifact type (offer letters, background check confirmations, security training records, I-9/ID verification receipts, access provision/deprovision logs) and indicates whether files are retained centrally or by manager teams.
- A sampling plan (how many records per cohort/time period) and the location/links where the sampled artifacts can be pulled.
- A small set (3–5) of redacted background check samples and one redacted training completion certificate sample for verification.

Can you confirm whether you can provide an index + sampling plan by end of day Friday (2025-07-18)? If there are any sensitive steps that need an alternative delivery channel (SFTP, secure Drive link, or DocuSign envelope for redactions), flag them in your reply.

Thank you — we want to minimize back-and-forth on the day of the review.

Regards,
Claire Jensen
Senior Auditor, BrightLine Security
claire@brightlineaudit.com

[attachment: formal-request.pdf (pdf)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Claire Jensen <claire@brightlineaudit.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 request — personnel evidence sampling and index

Hi Claire,

Thanks — we can produce the index and a short sampling plan by Friday. Looping in Ben (HR ops lead) and Karthik (security/compliance) to assemble the artifacts and confirm retention locations.

Because some background check records contain PII, we'll plan to provide redacted samples via a secure Drive folder with restricted access. If BrightLine prefers SFTP, we can arrange that; otherwise Drive link + audit log should suffice.

Ben/Karthik — action items: can you please compile a single spreadsheet listing artifact types, storage location (Drive path / HR system), owner, retention policy, and a recommended sample set for the period Jan–Jun 2025? Also attach 3 redacted background-checks and one training certificate sample. Naomi will coordinate delivery to Claire.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 request — personnel evidence sampling and index

Naomi — quick update. I've pulled a draft index from HRIS and the access logs:

- Artifact types enumerated (sheet): offer_letter, signed_agreement, background_check_result, background_check_consent, security_training_completion, id_verification_scan, I-9, provisioning_ticket, deprovisioning_ticket, termination_confirmation.
- Locations: HRIS (Workday) for offer letters and signed agreements (links redacted), secure Drive folder for scanned IDs and redacted checks, Okta logs + internal provisioning tracker for access grant/revoke.
- Retention: 7 years for payroll/work authorization (policy), 3 years for training records (policy).

I'm attaching the draft spreadsheet and a couple redacted background-check PDFs (names replaced with initials). Also include a first-pass sampling matrix for Jan–Jun 2025 (n=20 across cohorts).

Attachments included: onboarding-evidence-index.xlsx, redacted-background-samples.zip

Ben
HR Operations Manager
ben@redwood.com

[attachment: onboarding-evidence-index.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[attachment: redacted-background-samples.zip (zip)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Claire Jensen <claire@brightlineaudit.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: SOC2 evidence — personnel onboarding/offboarding artifact index & sampling plan

Claire — attached is the consolidated index and the sampling plan per your ask. Highlights/notes: 

- File: onboarding-evidence-index.xlsx — master index with artifact types, canonical storage location (Drive folder IDs), owner contact, retention policy, and a suggested sample pool (cohort buckets by hire month).
- File: sampling-plan.pdf — describes sampling methodology (random stratified sampling by hire-month cohort + targeted selections for employees with elevated privileges).
- File: redacted-background-samples.zip — three redacted background check PDFs (initials only) and one redacted training certificate (pdf).

Delivery method: secure Drive folder with view-only access granted to brightline.audit@brightlineaudit.com. Link below; access logs will be provided on request. If you need SFTP instead we can move the zipped redacted set to a pre-provisioned endpoint.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example-index
HubSpot ticket: BRG-98765

Let me know if the sampling size (n=20) looks reasonable or if you prefer a larger population for the privilege cohort. We can also schedule a 30-minute walkthrough next week to show where items live and how redaction was performed.

Thanks,
